function makeBelt(

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/belt.ts:44

Builds the seeded particle annulus for a kind: belt catalog entry — the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter, the Kuiper belt beyond Neptune. Returns the Points object that becomes the node's mesh; its raycast is a no-op by contract (non-pickable detail).

Catalog entry — def.belt carries inner/outer/count/puff, def.color tints the particles, def.id seeds the LCG.
